title: Timeouts are survival
prompt:
1. `static int readWithBudget(java.io.Reader r, int budgetChars)` — read up to
budgetChars characters into a String, then return the string LENGTH (simulates a
bounded read; use the reader's real read(char[]) loop).
2. `static long elapsedOf(java.util.function.Supplier<?> work)` — nanoTime around
work.get(), return elapsed nanos (the shape of every timeout guard).
3. `static String statusFor(long elapsedNanos, long deadlineNanos)` — return
"ok" if elapsed <= deadline else "timeout".

tests.name: bounded reads and deadline checks
tests.hint: Every read has a budget; every op has a deadline.
